title: YAMNet audio event detection
description: Implement plan at .omc/plans/yamnet-audio-event-detection.md (REVISION 2). Detect non-speech audio events (laughter, cough, pet sounds, etc.) via locally-run YAMNet ONNX classifier wired into the Pipecat pipeline. Opt-in via Settings, surfaced on the watch dashboard.

stories.title: Static data + class map (src/audio_event/__init__.py, class_map.py)
stories.description: Create the audio_event package with the 521-entry AUDIOSET_CLASSES list and a hardcoded ALLOWLIST dict mapping ~18 curated AudioSet indices to display labels. label_for_index(idx) returns the allowlisted label or None.
acceptanceCriteria: src/audio_event/__init__.py exists
src/audio_event/class_map.py exports AUDIOSET_CLASSES with len == 521
ALLOWLIST is a literal dict[int, str] (no substring matching, no runtime construction)
ALLOWLIST contains entries for: Laughter, Giggle, Cough, Sneeze, Screaming, Crying, Yawn, Whispering, Bark, Howl, Bow-wow, Whimper (dog), Meow, Purr, Hiss, Caterwaul, Bird vocalization, Crowing
label_for_index(0) returns None (Speech is not allowlisted)
label_for_index(idx) returns 'Laughter' for the laughter index
Module imports do not require numpy or onnxruntime

stories.title: Classifier wrapper (src/audio_event/classifier.py)
stories.description: YamnetClassifier wraps onnxruntime.InferenceSession. classify(waveform) takes float32 mono 16 kHz audio (15360 samples = 0.96 s) and returns 521 (idx, score) pairs sorted descending. Module docstring contains tf2onnx conversion recipe.
acceptanceCriteria: src/audio_event/classifier.py defines class YamnetClassifier
Class constants WINDOW_SAMPLES = 15360 and SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
__init__(model_path) raises FileNotFoundError if path missing
classify(waveform) raises ValueError if len(waveform) != WINDOW_SAMPLES
classify returns list[tuple[int, float]] of length 521 sorted descending by score
Module-level docstring includes tf2onnx conversion recipe with --opset 13 and the tfhub.dev/google/yamnet/1 source URL

stories.title: Atomic writer (src/audio_event/writer.py)
stories.description: write_audio_event(path, label, score) writes {label, score, ts} JSON atomically via tmpfile + os.replace. Lives in src/audio_event/, NOT in voice_state_observer.py.
acceptanceCriteria: src/audio_event/writer.py defines write_audio_event(path: Path, label: str, score: float) -> None
Output JSON has exactly the keys {label, score, ts}
score is rounded to 3 decimals
Write is atomic (tmpfile + os.replace)
Parent directory is created if missing
OSError during write is caught and logged (does not raise)
src/pipeline/stages/voice_state_observer.py is not modified

stories.title: Observer + factory (src/audio_event/observer.py)
stories.description: AudioEventObserver(FrameProcessor) accumulates InputAudioRawFrame bytes, schedules inference via asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(_infer)) with task.add_done_callback(_on_result). Drops next window when _running. Emits event on 2-consecutive-window agreement above threshold. _on_result resets _running in finally block. Factory create_audio_event_observer returns None on disabled / missing onnxruntime / missing model file with a warning log.
acceptanceCriteria: src/audio_event/observer.py defines class AudioEventObserver(FrameProcessor)
process_frame uses asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(self._infer, ...)) + task.add_done_callback
_on_result reads fut.result() inside try/except and resets self._running in finally
When _running is True, accumulated buffer is discarded for the next window
Event is emitted only when current label matches _prev_label (2-window confirmation)
Below-threshold predictions do not trigger event emission
Observer is pass-through (always pushes the frame downstream)
create_audio_event_observer returns None when settings.audio_event_detection_enabled is False
create_audio_event_observer returns None when onnxruntime ImportError occurs (logged)
create_audio_event_observer returns None when model file missing (logged)

stories.title: Settings fields (src/config.py)
stories.description: Add audio_event_detection_enabled, audio_event_threshold, yamnet_model_path, audio_event_file fields to Settings dataclass.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings.audio_event_detection_enabled: bool = False
Settings.audio_event_threshold: float = 0.4
Settings.yamnet_model_path defaults to HEARE_HOME / 'models' / 'yamnet.onnx'
Settings.audio_event_file defaults to HEARE_HOME / 'audio_event.json'

stories.title: Pipeline wiring (src/pipeline/build.py)
stories.description: _assemble_native_stages gains audio_event_observer kwarg (placed immediately after input_mute_gate parameter). build_pipeline conditionally constructs the observer behind a try/except guarded by settings.audio_event_detection_enabled and inserts it between input_mute_gate and speaker_buffer in the stage list.
acceptanceCriteria: _assemble_native_stages signature includes audio_event_observer: Any = None
audio_event_observer kwarg is positioned after input_mute_gate kwarg in the signature
Stage list places audio_event_observer between input_mute_gate and speaker_buffer when supplied
build_pipeline imports src.audio_event.observer ONLY inside the if settings.audio_event_detection_enabled block (no top-level import)
Observer construction is wrapped in try/except so failure logs and continues without crashing
Existing pipeline still builds with audio_event_detection_enabled=False (default)

stories.title: Dashboard data layer (src/watch/data.py)
stories.description: Add AudioEventData frozen dataclass + read_audio_event(path) reader that returns defaults on missing/corrupt file. Add audio_event field to DashboardSnapshot. fetch_dashboard_state populates it.
acceptanceCriteria: AudioEventData(label: str | None, score: float, ts: float) frozen dataclass exists
read_audio_event(path) returns AudioEventData(label=None, score=0.0, ts=0.0) on missing file
read_audio_event returns defaults on corrupt JSON (no exception escapes)
DashboardSnapshot has audio_event: AudioEventData field
fetch_dashboard_state populates audio_event via read_audio_event(settings.audio_event_file)

stories.title: Widget + app wiring (src/watch/widgets.py, src/watch/app.py)
stories.description: VoiceStateBar.refresh_data gains audio_event parameter. Renders event line when label is present and ts within EVENT_TTL_S (5.0s) decay window. app.py call site is updated to pass both args.
acceptanceCriteria: VoiceStateBar.refresh_data(self, voice, audio_event) — second parameter added
VoiceStateBar.EVENT_TTL_S = 5.0
Widget renders an event line when audio_event.label is not None and time.time() - audio_event.ts < EVENT_TTL_S
Event line is hidden when ts is older than EVENT_TTL_S (auto-decay)
src/watch/app.py call site invokes voice_bar.refresh_data(snapshot.voice_state, snapshot.audio_event)

stories.title: Optional dependency group (pyproject.toml)

acceptanceCriteria: pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies] has audio-event = ['onnxruntime>=1.17', 'numpy>=1.24']
onnxruntime is NOT in core dependencies
